product.name: DataShield
product.value_proposition: Real-time data loss prevention for Salesforce instances, preventing insider threats and compliance violations
product.competitive_positioning: Unlike generic DLP solutions, DataShield is Salesforce-native, requires zero external infrastructure, and costs 40% less than Varonis

target_audience.primary_persona: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) or Head of Data Governance at mid-market SaaS/tech companies (100-1000 employees)
target_audience.psychographics: Risk-averse, heavily regulated, spending 2-4 hours/week researching security tools, influenced by peer recommendations and analyst reports

market_trends: Post-acquisition consolidation: Varonis acquired by STG 2023, deprioritizing mid-market
Rise of AI-driven insider threat detection
Increased regulatory pressure (EU AI Act, SOX compliance)
